summary: Implemented a categorized unit, integration, and API test harness; native Node coverage with enforced thresholds; real TypeScript/JavaScript linting; a reproducible local quality command; and a basic Node 24 GitHub Actions workflow. Added guarded optional live MongoDB verification that refuses non-test environments and reports a missing isolated URI as blocked. No product route, DTO, database model, or frontend behavior was added; runtime inventory remains exactly GET /health and GET /ready.
